!Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_ 7.5hrsAwake_at18:15afterSleepExtension_Per3_4\4genotype_Subject_AF0004
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 18:15 following  7.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Extension protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0004)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

The tube is transferred to -50°C and placed lying down (never in upright position as this may cause the tube to crack) for storage at the university of Surrey Clinical Research Centre. The tube is transferred on ice to University of Surrey Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences for storage/processing
!Sample_growth_protocol_ch1 = Blood samples were collected via an indwelling venous cannula sited in the forearm for minimum discomfort and restriction of movement. Cannulae were kept patent by the use of sterile saline. Each sample tube was coded for subject and sample collection time (participant code/sample type/sequential number)
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_25.5hrsAwake_at12:15afterSleepExtension_Per3_4\4genotype_Subject_AF0004
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 12:15 following 25.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Extension protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0004)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_13.5hrsAwake_at00:15afterSleepRestriction_Per3_4\4genotype_Subject_AF0004
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 00:15 following 13.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Restriction protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0004)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. !Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_28.5hrsAwake_at14:47afterSleepExtension_Per3_4\4genotype_Subject_AF0010
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 14:47 following 28.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Extension protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0010)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = 2.5 ml of blood is drawn into the PAXGene tube at each sampling point. The tube is inverted 10 times to mix. !Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_16.5hrsAwake_at01:40afterSleepRestriction_Per3_4\4genotype_Subject_AF0010
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 01:40 following 16.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Restriction protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0010)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_34.5hrsAwake_at19:40afterSleepRestriction_Per3_4\4genotype_Subject_AF0010
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 19:40 following 34.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Restriction protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0010)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. !Sample_characteristics_ch1 = hoursawake: 7.5
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = timesampletaken: 17:35
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = circadianphase: -12
!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = 2.5 ml of blood is drawn into the PAXGene tube at each sampling point. The tube is inverted 10 times to mix. The tube is then stored at room temperature for 4 hours in upright position. The tube is transferred to -50°C and placed lying down (never in upright position as this may cause the tube to crack) for storage at the university of Surrey Clinical Research Centre. The tube is transferred on ice to University of Surrey Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences for storage/processing
!Sample_growth_protocol_ch1 = Blood samples were collected via an indwelling venous cannula sited in the forearm for minimum discomfort and restriction of movement. Cannulae were kept patent by the use of sterile saline. Each sample tube was coded for subject and sample collection time (participant code/sample type/sequential number)
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_ 7.5hrsAwake_at17:35afterSleepExtension_Per3_4\4genotype_Subject_AF0069
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 17:35 following  7.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Extension protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0069)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = sleepprotocol: Sleep Extension
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = genotype/variation: 4\4
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = hoursawake: 28.5
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = timesampletaken: 14:35
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = circadianphase: 9
!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = 2.5 ml of blood is drawn into the PAXGene tube at each sampling point. The tube is inverted 10 times to mix. The tube is then stored at room temperature for 4 hours in upright position. The tube is transferred to -50°C and placed lying down (never in upright position as this may cause the tube to crack) for storage at the university of Surrey Clinical Research Centre. The tube is transferred on ice to University of Surrey Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences for storage/processing
!Sample_growth_protocol_ch1 = Blood samples were collected via an indwelling venous cannula sited in the forearm for minimum discomfort and restriction of movement. Cannulae were kept patent by the use of sterile saline. Each sample tube was coded for subject and sample collection time (participant code/sample type/sequential number)
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_28.5hrsAwake_at14:35afterSleepExtension_Per3_4\4genotype_Subject_AF0069
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 14:35 following 28.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Extension protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0069)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.

!Sample_description = Blood taken at 04:35 following 19.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Restriction protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0069)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_ 7.5hrsAwake_at17:10afterSleepRestriction_Per3_4\4genotype_Subject_AF0079
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 17:10 following  7.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Restriction protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0079)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. !Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = 2.5 ml of blood is drawn into the PAXGene tube at each sampling point. The tube is inverted 10 times to mix. The tube is then stored at room temperature for 4 hours in upright position. !Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_19.5hrsAwake_at05:00afterSleepExtension_Per3_4\4genotype_Subject_AF0089
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 05:00 following 19.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Extension protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0089)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = hoursawake: 7.5
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = timesampletaken: 16:00
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = circadianphase: -15
!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = 2.5 ml of blood is drawn into the PAXGene tube at each sampling point. The tube is inverted 10 times to mix. The tube is then stored at room temperature for 4 hours in upright position. The tube is transferred to -50°C and placed lying down (never in upright position as this may cause the tube to crack) for storage at the university of Surrey Clinical Research Centre. The tube is transferred on ice to University of Surrey Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences for storage/processing
!Sample_growth_protocol_ch1 = Blood samples were collected via an indwelling venous cannula sited in the forearm for minimum discomfort and restriction of movement. Cannulae were kept patent by the use of sterile saline. Each sample tube was coded for subject and sample collection time (participant code/sample type/sequential number)
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_ 7.5hrsAwake_at16:00afterSleepRestriction_Per3_4\4genotype_Subject_AF0089
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 16:00 following  7.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Restriction protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0089)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3

!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.

!Sample_description = Blood taken at 10:00 following 25.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Restriction protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0089)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_19.5hrsAwake_at02:40afterSleepRestriction_Per3_5\5genotype_Subject_AF0091
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 02:40 following 19.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Restriction protocol from a Per3 5\5 genotype subject (Subject AF0091)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.

!Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_31.5hrsAwake_at16:15afterSleepExtension_Per3_4\4genotype_Subject_AF0094
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 16:15 following 31.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Extension protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0094)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = 2.5 ml of blood is drawn into the PAXGene tube at each sampling point. The tube is inverted 10 times to mix. The tube is then stored at room temperature for 4 hours in upright position. The tube is transferred to -50°C and placed lying down (never in upright position as this may cause the tube to crack) for storage at the university of Surrey Clinical Research Centre. The tube is transferred on ice to University of Surrey Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences for storage/processing

!Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_19.5hrsAwake_at03:15afterSleepRestriction_Per3_4\4genotype_Subject_AF0094
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 03:15 following 19.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Restriction protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0094)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_ 7.5hrsAwake_at15:25afterSleepExtension_Per3_5\5genotype_Subject_AF0101
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 15:25 following  7.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Extension protocol from a Per3 5\5 genotype subject (Subject AF0101)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. !Sample_source_name_ch1 = Blood_19.5hrsAwake_at03:55afterSleepExtension_Per3_4\4_genotype
!Sample_organism_ch1 = Homo sapiens
!Sample_taxid_ch1 = 9606
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = subject: AF0112
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = tissue: Blood
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = sleepprotocol: Sleep Extension
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = genotype/variation: 4\4
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = hoursawake: 19.5
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = timesampletaken: 3:55
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = circadianphase: 0
!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = 2.5 ml of blood is drawn into the PAXGene tube at each sampling point. The tube is inverted 10 times to mix. The tube is then stored at room temperature for 4 hours in upright position. The tube is transferred to -50°C and placed lying down (never in upright position as this may cause the tube to crack) for storage at the university of Surrey Clinical Research Centre. The tube is transferred on ice to University of Surrey Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences for storage/processing
!Sample_growth_protocol_ch1 = Blood samples were collected via an indwelling venous cannula sited in the forearm for minimum discomfort and restriction of movement. Cannulae were kept patent by the use of sterile saline. Each sample tube was coded for subject and sample collection time (participant code/sample type/sequential number)
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_19.5hrsAwake_at03:55afterSleepExtension_Per3_4\4genotype_Subject_AF0112
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 03:55 following 19.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Extension protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0112)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. !Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. !Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_13.5hrsAwake_at23:20afterSleepExtension_Per3_4\4genotype_Subject_AF0114
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 23:20 following 13.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Extension protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0114)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. !Sample_characteristics_ch1 = circadianphase: 0
!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = 2.5 ml of blood is drawn into the PAXGene tube at each sampling point. The tube is inverted 10 times to mix. The tube is then stored at room temperature for 4 hours in upright position. The tube is transferred to -50°C and placed lying down (never in upright position as this may cause the tube to crack) for storage at the university of Surrey Clinical Research Centre. The tube is transferred on ice to University of Surrey Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences for storage/processing
!Sample_growth_protocol_ch1 = Blood samples were collected via an indwelling venous cannula sited in the forearm for minimum discomfort and restriction of movement. Cannulae were kept patent by the use of sterile saline. Each sample tube was coded for subject and sample collection time (participant code/sample type/sequential number)
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_22.5hrsAwake_at07:23afterSleepRestriction_Per3_4\4genotype_Subject_AF0114
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 07:23 following 22.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Restriction protocol from a Per3 4\4 genotype subject (Subject AF0114)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = hoursawake: 13.5
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = timesampletaken: 21:35
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = circadianphase: -6
!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = 2.5 ml of blood is drawn into the PAXGene tube at each sampling point. The tube is inverted 10 times to mix. The tube is then stored at room temperature for 4 hours in upright position. The tube is transferred to -50°C and placed lying down (never in upright position as this may cause the tube to crack) for storage at the university of Surrey Clinical Research Centre. The tube is transferred on ice to University of Surrey Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences for storage/processing
!Sample_growth_protocol_ch1 = Blood samples were collected via an indwelling venous cannula sited in the forearm for minimum discomfort and restriction of movement. Cannulae were kept patent by the use of sterile saline. Each sample tube was coded for subject and sample collection time (participant code/sample type/sequential number)
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_13.5hrsAwake_at21:35afterSleepExtension_Per3_5\5genotype_Subject_AF0122
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 21:35 following 13.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Extension protocol from a Per3 5\5 genotype subject (Subject AF0122)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_31.5hrsAwake_at15:35afterSleepExtension_Per3_5\5genotype_Subject_AF0122
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 15:35 following 31.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Extension protocol from a Per3 5\5 genotype subject (Subject AF0122)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = hoursawake: 25.5
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = timesampletaken: 8:45
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = circadianphase: 6
!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = 2.5 ml of blood is drawn into the PAXGene tube at each sampling point. The tube is inverted 10 times to mix. The tube is then stored at room temperature for 4 hours in upright position. The tube is transferred to -50°C and placed lying down (never in upright position as this may cause the tube to crack) for storage at the university of Surrey Clinical Research Centre. The tube is transferred on ice to University of Surrey Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences for storage/processing
!Sample_growth_protocol_ch1 = Blood samples were collected via an indwelling venous cannula sited in the forearm for minimum discomfort and restriction of movement. Cannulae were kept patent by the use of sterile saline. Each sample tube was coded for subject and sample collection time (participant code/sample type/sequential number)
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_25.5hrsAwake_at08:45afterSleepExtension_Per3_5\5genotype_Subject_AF0139
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 08:45 following 25.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Extension protocol from a Per3 5\5 genotype subject (Subject AF0139)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = hoursawake: 25.5
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = timesampletaken: 7:45
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = circadianphase: 3
!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = 2.5 ml of blood is drawn into the PAXGene tube at each sampling point. The tube is inverted 10 times to mix. The tube is then stored at room temperature for 4 hours in upright position. The tube is transferred to -50°C and placed lying down (never in upright position as this may cause the tube to crack) for storage at the university of Surrey Clinical Research Centre. The tube is transferred on ice to University of Surrey Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences for storage/processing
!Sample_growth_protocol_ch1 = Blood samples were collected via an indwelling venous cannula sited in the forearm for minimum discomfort and restriction of movement. Cannulae were kept patent by the use of sterile saline. Each sample tube was coded for subject and sample collection time (participant code/sample type/sequential number)
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_25.5hrsAwake_at07:45afterSleepRestriction_Per3_5\5genotype_Subject_AF0139
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 07:45 following 25.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Restriction protocol from a Per3 5\5 genotype subject (Subject AF0139)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_16.5hrsAwake_at02:50afterSleepExtension_Per3_5\5genotype_Subject_AF0145
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 02:50 following 16.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Extension protocol from a Per3 5\5 genotype subject (Subject AF0145)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. !Sample_source_name_ch1 = Blood_25.5hrsAwake_at10:50afterSleepRestriction_Per3_5\5_genotype
!Sample_organism_ch1 = Homo sapiens
!Sample_taxid_ch1 = 9606
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = subject: AF0145
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = tissue: Blood
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = sleepprotocol: Sleep Restriction
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = genotype/variation: 5\5
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = hoursawake: 25.5
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = timesampletaken: 10:50
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = circadianphase: 3
!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = 2.5 ml of blood is drawn into the PAXGene tube at each sampling point. The tube is inverted 10 times to mix. The tube is then stored at room temperature for 4 hours in upright position. The tube is transferred to -50°C and placed lying down (never in upright position as this may cause the tube to crack) for storage at the university of Surrey Clinical Research Centre. The tube is transferred on ice to University of Surrey Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences for storage/processing
!Sample_growth_protocol_ch1 = Blood samples were collected via an indwelling venous cannula sited in the forearm for minimum discomfort and restriction of movement. Cannulae were kept patent by the use of sterile saline. Each sample tube was coded for subject and sample collection time (participant code/sample type/sequential number)
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_25.5hrsAwake_at10:50afterSleepRestriction_Per3_5\5genotype_Subject_AF0145
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 10:50 following 25.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Restriction protocol from a Per3 5\5 genotype subject (Subject AF0145)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = sleepprotocol: Sleep Extension
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = genotype/variation: 5\5
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = hoursawake: 13.5
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = timesampletaken: 20:45
!Sample_characteristics_ch1 = circadianphase: -6
!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1 = 2.5 ml of blood is drawn into the PAXGene tube at each sampling point. The tube is inverted 10 times to mix. The tube is then stored at room temperature for 4 hours in upright position. The tube is transferred to -50°C and placed lying down (never in upright position as this may cause the tube to crack) for storage at the university of Surrey Clinical Research Centre. The tube is transferred on ice to University of Surrey Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences for storage/processing
!Sample_growth_protocol_ch1 = Blood samples were collected via an indwelling venous cannula sited in the forearm for minimum discomfort and restriction of movement. Cannulae were kept patent by the use of sterile saline. Each sample tube was coded for subject and sample collection time (participant code/sample type/sequential number)
!Sample_molecule_ch1 = total RNA
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1 = Total RNA was isolated using a PAXgene Blood RNA Kit and a QiaCube robot (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany). The RNA was quantified and the A260/280 nm and A260/230 nm ratios were determined using a NanoDrop ND1000 spectrophotometer (Wilmington, DE). RNA quality was assessed using the Bioanalyzer 2100 (Agilent, Santa Clara, CA).
!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_13.5hrsAwake_at20:45afterSleepExtension_Per3_5\5genotype_Subject_AF0164
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 20:45 following 13.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Extension protocol from a Per3 5\5 genotype subject (Subject AF0164)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.

!Sample_label_ch1 = Cy3
!Sample_label_protocol_ch1 = cRNA was synthesized and fluorescently labelled with Cy3-CTP from 100 ng of total RNA using Agilent's Low Input Quick Amp Labeling Kit.
!Sample_hyb_protocol = Labelled cRNA (1.65 μg) was hybridized on a Whole Human Genome 4 x 44K custom oligonucleotide microarray (G2514F, AMADID 026817; Agilent Technologies). Standard manufacturer's instructions for one-colour gene expression hybridization and washing steps were followed. The microarrays were hybridized at 65°C for 17 h in an Agilent hybridization oven with rotisserie at 10 rpm. The microarrays were washed with Agilent Wash Buffer 1, pre-warmed Wash Buffer 2 (37°C) and acetonitrile according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The last washing step was performed with Agilent Stabilization and Drying Solution for 30 sec.
!Sample_scan_protocol = The processed microarrays were scanned using an Agilent Microarray Scanner with a resolution of 5 μm, exploiting the extended dynamic range feature. The two images derived from each slide scanned at 10% and 100% PMT were imported into Agilent Feature Extraction software (Version 10.7.1.1) for image analysis.
!Sample_description = Blood_31.5hrsAwake_at14:45afterSleepExtension_Per3_5\5genotype_Subject_AF0164
!Sample_description = Blood taken at 14:45 following 31.5 hours awake after following a Sleep Extension protocol from a Per3 5\5 genotype subject (Subject AF0164)
!Sample_data_processing = Individual samples were filtered based on AgilentQC metrics of reproducibility statistics, minimum detection level estimates and feature flags. Samples with a median coefficient of variation of less than 10% in spike ins or non-control replicated probes (NCRPs) were retained and quantile-normalized using the R Bioconductor package limma. NCRPs along with their corresponding flags were averaged. Probes with more than 5 flagged samples within a subject in more than half of the total number of subjects were excluded. In addition, for time-series analyses, series with 2 consecutive or more than 2 missing time points were excluded.
